title: padus obovata
intro: Padus obovata, commonly known as the Mayapple or Chinese Padus, is a deciduous shrub native to East Asia. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Padus obovata include its use as an analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic agent, making it useful in the treatment of fever, pain, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Padus obovata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
